name: Nothing Phone 3a/Pro
tagline: Experience the perfect blend of performance and customization with our Pixel-inspired custom ROM for your device.

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.description:
• Ensure your device's bootloader is unlocked.
• Backup your data! A clean flash will wipe all data.
• Use official latest Google Platform-Tools (avoid outdated Minimal ADB/Fastboot).
• Note: Separate images like boot.img, dtbo.img, vendor_boot.img, and init_boot.img are NOT required.

steps.title: Reboot to Bootloader
steps.description:
Connect your phone via USB and reboot to Bootloader by typing:
adb reboot bootloader
Alternatively, power off the phone and hold Volume Down + Power.

steps.title: Reboot to FastbootD
steps.description:
From bootloader mode, reboot to FastbootD by typing:
fastboot reboot fastboot

steps.title: Flash Recovery (Only Required if Coming from Stock NothingOS)
steps.description:
If coming from Stock Nothing OS, flash the recovery image:
fastboot flash recovery recovery.img
Then reboot into the new recovery's FastbootD mode:
fastboot reboot bootloader
fastboot reboot fastboot
(Skip this step if coming from another custom ROM or dirty updating).

steps.title: Wipe Super Partition (Only Required if Coming from Stock or Another ROM that is not using 6.1 kernel)
steps.description:
While in FastbootD mode, wipe the super partition by typing:
fastboot wipe-super super_empty.img
(Required for clean flash when coming from Stock or another ROM; skip if dirty updating).

steps.title: Reboot to Recovery
steps.description:
Reboot into Recovery mode by typing:
fastboot reboot recovery

steps.title: Sideload Clover ROM
steps.description:
In recovery, navigate to Apply Update → Apply from ADB, then sideload the ROM by typing:
adb sideload CloverProject*.zip
• Note: Sideload progress frequently pauses at 47% or 94% — this is completely normal.
• If prompted to install additional packages, choose No.

steps.title: Factory Reset / Format Data
steps.description:
From the main recovery menu, select Factory Reset → Format data/factory reset and confirm.
(Skip this step if you are dirty updating / upgrading from an earlier build of this ROM).

steps.title: Reboot to System
steps.description: Select Reboot system now. The first boot may take a few minutes. Enjoy Clover!

installationGuide.warning: Incorrect installation may brick your device. We are not responsible for any damage to your device. Proceed at your own risk.
